REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE. S.B. REGISTRY. File No. 368）
Date September 11, 1940.

Subject Victor Sydney Elliot alias Vincent Lorraine alias Garry alias
A. Smith, Eurasian. (unrecognized).

Made by and Forwarded by D. S. I. Logan.

& Records Files:-
E 202 + H1270 +
C.I.D. 8106

Victor Sydney Elliot alias Vincent
Lorraine alias Garry alias A. Smith, was born
at Shanghai on 27/6/1899, his mother being a
Chinese U.S.A. citizen. Particulars concerning
his father are not known but it is known that
Elliot was, in 1901, registered in the U.S.
Consulate-General at Shanghai. Elliot is
married, of the Roman Catholic faith, height
5'9½", weight about 170 lbs., well built,
hair - black, turning grey, eyes - brown,
nose - broken and has a cut scar on base of
right nostril.

Elliot first came to the notice of
the Police in 1923, when he was employed by
Messrs. Calbeck, MacGregor & Co., from whom
he embezzled certain monies and on whom he
perpetrated several cases of forgery. In
this connection he was arrested by the U.S.
Court for China authorities as a result of an
affadavit sworn by Mr. J.J. Sherridan of said
Company. The matter was, however, settled
out of Court on payment of the embezzled money
by Elliot's mother's paramour, one named
Mr. Zetterland.

In 1925 Elliot went to the U.S.A.
in order to evade arrest in Shanghai for forging

日期：1940年9月11日。

事由：Victor Sydney Elliot，又名 Vincent Lorraine，又名 Garry，又名 A. Smith，欧亚混血儿。（身份未获承认）。

撰写及呈报人：D. S. I. Logan。

及相关档案卷宗：-
E 202 + H1270 +
刑事侦缉处（C.I.D.）8106

Victor Sydney Elliot，又名 Vincent Lorraine，又名 Garry，又名 A. Smith，于1899年6月27日出生于上海，其母为美籍华人。关于其父的情况不详，但已知 Elliot 曾于1901年在上海美国总领事馆登记注册。Elliot 已婚，信奉罗马天主教，身高5英尺9½英寸，体重约170磅，体格健壮，头发黑色，渐现灰白，眼睛褐色，鼻梁断裂，右鼻孔基部有一道割伤疤痕。

Elliot 首次引起警方注意是在1923年，当时他受雇于 Calbeck, MacGregor & Co. 公司（音译），期间侵吞该公司款项，并多次伪造文件诈骗该公司。为此，基于该公司 J.J. Sherridan 先生（音译）宣誓作出的证词，他被在华美国法院当局逮捕。然而，此事最终通过庭外和解解决，由 Elliot 母亲的情夫，一名名为 Zetterland 先生（音译）的人代为偿还了被侵吞的款项。

其母亲姓名，在美洲东方银行（American and Oriental Bank）开具并兑现的16张支票上进行伪造一事。他在旧金山因持用不符合规定的护照进入美国而被捕，被判监禁60天，出狱后被驱逐出境。被驱逐返回上海后，他抵达此处时即根据在华美国法院的逮捕令被捕，并应其母亲的要求，就上述16起伪造案件受到指控。他成功否认了在华美国法院的管辖权，因而被释放，但随后在混合法庭被控盗窃其母亲价值1,000.00美元的珠宝，并于1926年1月19日被判处监禁3个月。前述伪造指控也在混合法庭对他提出，定罪后，他于1926年4月18日被判处监禁2年。这些伪造指控涉及的金额为5,500.00美元。
他于1927年10月4日因减刑获释。1930年7月29日，他再次在中国法院出庭，面临8项欺诈指控，被判处监禁6个月，并被责令缴纳罚款600.00美元。在这

which he ordered various quantities of goods
without any intention to pay for same.    The
next time that Elliot was heard of was in 1932
when he was wanted on a Hongkong magistrate's
warrant of arrest for having, concerned together
with a Portuguese named Souza, fraudulently
obtained the sum of $20,000.00 from a Chinese
in the said colony.    As far as is known,
Elliot escaped arrest on this charge.    Elliot
was next heard of in Tientsin where, on 19.2.33,
he was fined $40.00 upon being convicted of
Fraud.    It is also known that Elliot appeared
in Court in Tientsin on 24.10.33, on a charge
of selling cocaine illegally but whether he
was convicted or not is not known.
    In July, 1935, it came to the notice
of the Police that Elliot was concerned with
a Spanish citizen, J.A. Valles, in obtaining
silk goods valued at $2,520.50 by means of
Fraud from the Seng Chong Silk & Lace Co., 119
Broadway, but the complainant withdrew the
charge upon the recovery of the greater part of
the property involved in the case.

8起欺诈案中使用的“作案手法”是，在圆明园路21号以“Ajax Far Eastern Trading Co.”（音译：阿贾克斯远东贸易公司）的名义设立一家虚假商号，通过该商号订购各种数量的货物，却无意支付货款。下一次听到 Elliot 的消息是在1932年，当时香港裁判官签发逮捕令通缉他，原因是他与一名名为 Souza 的葡萄牙人合谋，在该殖民地诈骗一名中国人20,000.00美元。据所知，Elliot 在此项指控中逃脱了逮捕。接下来得知 Elliot 的消息是在天津，1933年2月19日，他因犯欺诈罪被定罪，罚款40.00美元。另悉，Elliot 于1933年10月24日在天津法庭因非法出售可卡因而受审，但是否定罪则不得而知。
1935年7月，警方获悉 Elliot 与一名西班牙公民 J.A. Valles 勾结，通过欺诈手段从位于百老汇路119号的盛昌丝绸花边公司（Seng Chong Silk & Lace Co.）骗取价值2,520.50美元的丝绸货物，但在追回该案涉及的大部分财物后，控告人撤回了指控。

Elliot was on 17.11.36, convicted in
the S.S.D. Court on a charge of assisting in
the sale of arms and sentenced to 3 years'
imprisonment. He appealed against this
sentence and on 9.2.37 the original judgment
was set aside and he was sentenced to 6 months'
suspended for two years.

Elliot again appeared before the S.S.D.
Court on a charge of Fraud and was sentenced to
one year's imprisonment on 16.8.38. On this
occasion his previous suspended sentence was
cancelled and he was ordered to serve a further
6 months' imprisonment. Released from jail
on 11.9.39, he eventually obtained a position,
which he still occupies, as a reporter on the
"Evening Echo" local evening newspaper.

From the foregoing it will be seen
that Elliot is a habitual criminal. He has
not hesitated to use aliases from time to time
in order to assist him in his criminal activities
or to cloak his true identity when it suited
his purpose.

Mogan
D. S. I.

D. C. ( Special Branch ).

1936年11月17日，Elliot 在特区地方法院（S.S.D. Court）因协助贩卖军火罪被定罪，判处监禁3年。他对这一判决提出上诉，1937年2月9日，原判被撤销，改判监禁6个月，缓刑两年。

Elliot 再次因欺诈罪出现在特区地方法院，并于1938年8月16日被判处监禁一年。此次，他之前的缓刑被取消，并被责令再服刑6个月。他于1939年9月11日获释，最终获得了一份职位，即本地晚报《Evening Echo》（音译：《回声晚报》）的记者，该职位他至今仍担任。

综上所述可见，Elliot 是一名惯犯。为了协助其犯罪活动，或在符合其目的时掩盖其真实身份，他毫不犹豫地不时使用化名。

Mogan
D. S. I. （督察长）

D. C. （特务科）
